title: Score, weigh, and blend
brief: Write the three pieces of a soft lookup: dot-product scores, a stable softmax, and the weighted blend of value rows.
hints: dot_scores is one line: q @ k.T. Row i, column j is the dot product of query i with key j, so the result has shape (T_q, T_k).
softmax: subtract np.max(x, axis=axis, keepdims=True) before np.exp, then divide by the sum of the exponentials along the same axis with keepdims=True.
blend_values is weights @ v. Each output row is a weighted average of the rows of v, so with weights [1, 0] you get exactly the first row of v.
